title: Introduce TFState rollback orchestrator and GPU profile operator for private deploys
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: operators running private Redwood clusters have reported difficult and risky manual rollbacks when a tfstate boundary change or GPU profile rebind is required. This PR delivers two coordinated pieces: (1) a lightweight, idempotent TFState Rollback Orchestrator (as a Terraform module + helper scripts) that records state transition plans, checkpoints state snapshots to the configured backend, and exposes a deterministic rollback command for on-call and upgrade tooling; (2) a new GPU Profile Operator module that standardizes nodepool labels, taint/affinity defaults, and upgrade-friendly instance template rotations so GPU node pools can be moved between tfstate boundaries with minimal pod disruption. The change set includes migration helpers, acceptance tests, updated docs, and CI pipeline steps to generate and validate a rollback plan.
commits: add: tfstate rollback orchestrator module and README
feat: gpu-profile operator module with taint/affinity defaults
chore: add state checkpoint helper and checksum verifier
test: add acceptance tests for rollback and nodepool rotation
ci: integrate plan/validate steps and gated apply for private installs
docs: expand private-deploys upgrade playbook and migration notes
review_comments: Alex Kim: This looks promising. Please add a short section about expected S3/GCS object retention and how the orchestrator avoids accidental erasure. Suggested: explicit retention TTL and a dry-run flag.
Priya Menon: Added retention TTL and dry-run in scripts (see scripts/tfstate-checkpoint.sh). Also wired dry-run into CI plan stage.
Samir Patel: Concern: rolling instance-template replacement may evict critical workloads. Can we support cordon/drain hooks and a graceful drain timeout?

Priya Menon: Implemented cordon/drain hooks and a configurable drain_timeout defaulting to 5m; documented behavior in gpu-profile-operator/README.md and added acceptance test that simulates long-running pods.
Marina Voss: CI flagged flaky e2e on first run — looks like a timing race during checkpoint creation. Recommend adding linear backoff retry on backend writes.
Priya Menon: Added exponential backoff and a checksum-verify step after checkpoint upload; reran CI and tests passed.
release_notes: Added a TFState Rollback Orchestrator to make state transitions auditable and reversible for private deployments. Introduced GPU Profile Operator module to standardize nodepool upgrades and reduce disruption during tfstate migrations. Includes migration helpers, docs, and gated CI validation for rollbacks.
